skill.summary: Display Ponytail modes, skill commands, configuration options, and update guidance without changing the current session.

content.user_title: Find Ponytail Commands and Mode Settings
content.value_statement: Ponytail users need a clear reference for modes, commands, and configuration. This skill displays that reference once without changing modes or saving state.
actual_capabilities: Display Lite, Full, and Ultra mode descriptions with their triggers.
List six Ponytail skills and describe their intended purposes.
Show documented Codex invocation syntax and slash-command forms for other supported hosts.
Present deactivation commands and manual activation options.
Explain default-mode settings and environment-variable precedence over configuration files.
Display plugin update guidance and the project documentation link.
limitations: Displays reference information only; it does not activate modes or save configuration.
Describes companion skills but does not perform reviews, audits, debt tracking, or gain measurements.
Does not verify installed plugin versions or host command availability.
Update guidance depends on the host and may change with future releases.

use_cases.title: Learn the available modes
use_cases.description: Read the Lite, Full, and Ultra descriptions before choosing a Ponytail mode.

use_cases.title: Find a review command
use_cases.description: Locate the companion skill for reviewing over-engineering or auditing an entire repository.

use_cases.title: Check configuration guidance
use_cases.description: Consult default-mode precedence, deactivation options, and host-specific update instructions without modifying settings.

prompt_templates.title: Show the reference
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: discover available modes and commands.

prompt_templates.title: Find mode controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Show Ponytail help so I can compare Lite, Full, and Ultra and find the deactivation commands.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: choose a mode without activating it.

prompt_templates.title: Locate companion skills
prompt_templates.prompt: Display Ponytail help with the review, audit, debt, and gain command descriptions. Do not invoke those skills.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: identify the appropriate companion command.

prompt_templates.title: Check defaults and updates
prompt_templates.prompt: Display Ponytail help, including default-mode precedence, Codex invocation syntax, and update guidance. Do not change configuration or run updates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: consult configuration and host-specific reference details.

output_examples.input: Show the Ponytail modes from the help card.
output: Lite: build the requested solution and name a simpler alternative.
Full: prioritize necessity, standard libraries, native features, and minimal implementation.
Ultra: question requirements and consider deletion before adding code.

output_examples.input: What does the help card say about default modes?
output: The environment variable takes precedence over the configuration file.
The configuration file takes precedence over the default.
The off setting disables automatic activation at session start.
Ponytail provides the main simplification mode.
Ponytail Review describes an over-engineering review.
Ponytail Audit describes a repository-wide over-engineering audit.
Ponytail Debt tracks shortcut comments, while Ponytail Gain reports measured impact.

best_practices: Consult the reference before selecting a mode or companion skill.
Use the documented invocation syntax for your host.
Review update and configuration instructions before applying changes separately.
anti_patterns: Expecting the help card to activate a mode or persist settings.
Treating listed companion capabilities as actions performed by this skill.
Assuming the reference verifies your installed version or command availability.

faq.question: Does displaying help change my current mode?
faq.answer: No. The skill explicitly requires a one-time display without mode changes, flag writes, or persistence.

faq.question: Which Ponytail levels are listed?
faq.answer: The reference lists Lite, Full, and Ultra. It identifies Full as the default.

faq.question: Does this skill review or audit my code?
faq.answer: No. It describes the separate review and audit skills and shows their triggers.

faq.question: How does default-mode precedence work?
faq.answer: The documented order is environment variable, configuration file, then Full. The off setting disables automatic activation.

faq.question: How do invocation forms differ between hosts?
faq.answer: The card documents dollar-prefixed, namespaced skill invocations for Codex and slash commands for Claude Code and OpenCode.

faq.question: Does the help skill install updates?
faq.answer: No. It displays plugin update guidance and Claude Code upgrade alternatives for users to apply separately.
